notes: Tags for folds: the Apron and Splash tools now tag their pieces. In Layout, Import from CAD knows each apron and splash, and which edge of which piece it came off, so Send to 3D folds aprons down (45° miter on blue lines) and splashes up by themselves. Hover a strip line to see its tag; right-click > Tag as for older drawings. The saw DXF is unchanged.
